name: Instances of the MiniZinc Challenge, 2008 to 2026
organizers: the MiniZinc Challenge organisers, Monash University
layout: <year>/<problem>/<problem>.mzn with its data files, <problem>*.dzn or <problem>*.json, beside it
terms: the instances of the MiniZinc Challenge, as the organisers archive them; no licence file in the collection
note: nineteen editions of the constraint programming competition, from 2008 to 2026. This repository keeps the manifest and the pinned commit, never the instances: tools/fetch_upstream.py clones it into a local cache. The CNF encodings are produced on demand by the MiniZinc and PicatSAT bridge. An instance is a model and a data file, not a single file.
